resources.string: The L7 connection uses fixed 5 GHz channel 149. Changing the region applies the channel settings for that region.
Wi-Fi Direct region of use
Mainland China · vehicle use
Other regions · conservative 2.4 GHz

For vehicle use in mainland China, Auto prefers upper 5 GHz channels starting with 149, with 2.4 GHz fallback after system rejection. Indoor-only channels 36–48 are excluded. Other regions are restricted to 2.4 GHz channels 1–11; local rules and system radio approval still apply. Changes take effect on the next connection.
